tropes.name: Enemies to lovers
tropes.description: Two people who start out openly opposed find the friction turning into attraction, and neither wants to admit it first.

tropes.name: Friends to lovers
tropes.description: A long, comfortable friendship tips over into something more, and the risk is losing what they already had.

tropes.name: Fake dating
tropes.description: Two characters pretend to be a couple for a practical reason, then have to keep up the act once real feelings get in the way.

tropes.name: Marriage of convenience
tropes.description: A wedding arranged for land, money, politics or papers forces strangers to share a life before they share any affection.

tropes.name: Slow burn
tropes.description: The attraction builds over most of the book, through small moments and near-misses, before anyone acts on it.

tropes.name: Love at first sight
tropes.description: One look is enough: the pair are certain almost immediately, and the story tests whether that certainty holds.

tropes.name: Second chance romance
tropes.description: Former partners meet again years after it ended and have to face why it fell apart before trying again.

tropes.name: Forbidden love
tropes.description: Family, law, faith or rank says these two must not be together, which makes every meeting a risk.

tropes.name: Love triangle
tropes.description: One character is pulled between two people who each offer a different version of the future.

tropes.name: Forced proximity
tropes.description: A storm, a shared cabin or a single remaining room keeps two people close long enough for walls to come down.

tropes.name: Grumpy and sunshine
tropes.description: A guarded cynic and a stubbornly cheerful optimist rub off on each other in ways neither expected.

tropes.name: Workplace rivals
tropes.description: Two competitors chasing the same promotion, prize or title keep trying to outdo each other until the rivalry turns personal.

tropes.name: The chosen one
tropes.description: A prophecy, bloodline or strange mark singles out an ordinary person to face something far bigger than them.

tropes.name: The quest
tropes.description: A group sets out to find, deliver or destroy one thing, and the road changes them more than the goal does.

tropes.name: The heist
tropes.description: A crew with clashing skills plans an impossible theft, and the plan starts failing the moment it begins.

tropes.name: Locked room mystery
tropes.description: A crime happens somewhere no one could have entered or left, and the explanation has to be fair to the reader.

tropes.name: Whodunit
tropes.description: A closed circle of suspects, each with something to hide, and a detective who has to work out which secret is the deadly one.

tropes.name: Revenge plot
tropes.description: Someone who was badly wronged spends the story getting even, and has to decide what the payback is worth.

tropes.name: Race against time
tropes.description: A hard deadline hangs over everything: a bomb, a curse, a closing door, and each delay costs something.

tropes.name: Rise of the rebellion
tropes.description: A scattered resistance tries to bring down a ruling power, and the protagonist is pulled into the fight.

tropes.name: Fish out of water
tropes.description: A character lands in a world with rules they do not know, and their mistakes reveal how strange it really is.

tropes.name: Time loop
tropes.description: The same day keeps restarting, and only one person remembers. Getting out means finally doing it right.

tropes.name: The hidden world
tropes.description: Behind ordinary life there is a secret society, magic or city, and the protagonist has just stumbled through the door.

tropes.name: Betrayal from within
tropes.description: Someone on the protagonist's own side has been working against them, and the reveal reshapes every earlier scene.

tropes.name: Fight for survival
tropes.description: Stranded, hunted or cut off, the characters have to keep each other alive with whatever they can find.

tropes.name: Conspiracy uncovered
tropes.description: A small, wrong detail leads to a plan reaching far higher than anyone wanted to believe.

tropes.name: The haunting
tropes.description: Something unseen has claimed a house or a family, and it does not want the newcomers to leave.

tropes.name: First contact
tropes.description: Humans meet a mind that is truly not like theirs, and every misunderstanding could be the last one.

tropes.name: Coming of age
tropes.description: A young character crosses from childhood to adulthood through one hard summer, loss or choice.

tropes.name: Mistaken identity
tropes.description: Someone is taken for someone else and decides, for better or worse, to play along.

tropes.name: Reluctant hero
tropes.description: The person best placed to save the day would much rather be anywhere else, and keeps looking for a way out.

tropes.name: Morally grey protagonist
tropes.description: The lead does questionable things for reasons the reader understands, and the story never fully lets them off the hook.

tropes.name: Found family
tropes.description: Misfits with nowhere else to belong slowly become the people who would do anything for each other.

tropes.name: The fallen mentor
tropes.description: The person who taught the hero everything is gone at the worst moment, and the student has to stand alone.

tropes.name: Unreliable narrator
tropes.description: The voice telling the story is wrong, lying or hiding something, and the reader slowly learns to doubt them.

tropes.name: Anti-hero
tropes.description: A protagonist without classic virtues, selfish, blunt or ruthless, who still ends up on the right side for their own reasons.

tropes.name: Secret royalty
tropes.description: An ordinary life hides a claim to a throne, and the people who know are not all friendly.

tropes.name: Redemption arc
tropes.description: Someone who did real harm tries to become better, and the story makes them earn it.

tropes.name: Sympathetic villain
tropes.description: The antagonist's goal makes painful sense, and in another story they might have been the hero.

tropes.name: The amnesiac
tropes.description: A character wakes up without their past, and what they learn about who they were is not all welcome.

tropes.name: Lone survivor
tropes.description: Everyone else from their old life is gone, and the survivor carries both the memories and the guilt.

tropes.name: The impostor
tropes.description: A character is living a borrowed identity, and every close relationship raises the stakes of being found out.

tropes.name: Gifted outsider
tropes.description: An unusually talented young person is treated as a tool by adults who do not see the cost.

tropes.name: Small town with secrets
tropes.description: Everyone knows everyone, which means everyone is also keeping quiet about something.

tropes.name: The sprawling city
tropes.description: A huge, crowded city where it is easy to vanish and hard to know who is watching.

tropes.name: Boarding school
tropes.description: Students living away from home form their own society, with its own rules, rivalries and secrets.

tropes.name: Generation ship
tropes.description: A sealed ship crossing the dark for centuries, where no one aboard has ever seen the world it left.

tropes.name: Isolated manor
tropes.description: A grand old house cut off by weather or distance, with too many rooms and too few ways out.

tropes.name: After the collapse
tropes.description: The old world ended and the story happens in what grew in its place, with scarcity shaping every choice.

tropes.name: The royal court
tropes.description: A palace full of etiquette, alliances and whispered threats, where a wrong word can cost a life.

tropes.name: On the road
tropes.description: The story keeps moving, town to town or planet to planet, so the characters never get to settle.

tropes.name: Cozy and low stakes
tropes.description: Warm, gentle and comforting: the problems are personal and small, and kindness usually wins.

tropes.name: Grimdark
tropes.description: A harsh world where power corrupts, victories are costly and the good guys are not always good.

tropes.name: Comedy of errors
tropes.description: Misunderstandings stack on top of each other until the whole situation collapses in a funny way.

tropes.name: Creeping dread
tropes.description: Nothing obviously wrong happens for a long time, but the feeling that something is off keeps growing.

tropes.name: Hope against the odds
tropes.description: Things are bleak, but the story believes people can make them better and shows them trying.

tropes.name: Tragic ending
tropes.description: The story is heading toward loss, and the reader feels it coming long before the characters do.

tropes.name: Happily ever after
tropes.description: However hard the journey, the ending is warm and the main couple or family ends up together.
